description: ADR-0120 D12 SUPPLEMENTAL scored corpus, selector-only (owner decision (가) option 1 of 2026-10-27): the 46 conversation-context cases: 20 of owner decisions D1 / D4 and context-eval fixes P7 / P10 (2026-10-26, nl-select.v68 / v69), agent-drafted 2026-10-26 and owner-approved as-is in the D12 batch of 2026-10-26; and 26 of the D4 strengthening (ctx-d4-009..034, owner decision of 2026-10-27, nl-select.v70: 20 open-question answers, which bring that label to 26, and 6 non-answers), agent-drafted and owner-approved as-is in the D12 batch of 2026-10-27; ctx-d1-005's text swapped by owner decision (나) of 2026-10-27, and ctx-p7-002's and ctx-d1-002's by the owner's pick of 2026-10-27 (ADR-0123 near duplicates; expectations and priors unchanged). Scope: `eval:nl` (read) and `eval:nl --mode read-regression` score these cases together with nl-intent.v1.json, and they count in both gates (per-entry, overall and wrong captures; a D4 answer gold is its own label `open-question`). They are NOT part of the ADR-0121 Q11 one-step planner gold (Q11 auto-includes nl-intent.v1.json only; the planner does not yet receive the listing context, an S2 activation blocker in DECISIONS). ADR-0123 applies: the selector-RAG pool lint and the embedding audit check them (overlap only; they are not in the RAG experiment split). Same schema as nl-intent.v1.json plus: `prior.turns` (chat turns since the previous listing), `prior.earlier` (the latest selection of each other source; an output for an earlier entry is grounded against it), `openQuestion` (the help-scope question shown: sources, language) and `expectAnswer` (the option a worded reply means; `expect` stays `none`; an `answer` naming another option, or an `answer` on a case without `expectAnswer`, is a wrong capture). Rendered exactly as the runtime renders them.
